official_measurement_examples.name: Part T scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: Approved Document T applies to new buildings other than dwellings and buildings undergoing a material change of use, subject to the statutory scope and exceptions.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2024 commencement
official_measurement_examples.fact: Circular 02/2024 states the new Part T changes came into force on 1 October 2024.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2025 revision
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 3 November 2025 revision corrected minor errors in Approved Document T tables and did not create a new planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Type versus quantity
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part T addresses specified types of toilet accommodation rather than setting a numeric toilet-count threshold for every building.

official_measurement_examples.name: Part G separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sanitary appliance numbers and general sanitation guidance remain distinct from Part T's specific toilet-type requirements.

official_measurement_examples.name: Part M separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Accessibility and use requirements in Part M remain separate from Part T toilet-type requirements.

official_measurement_examples.name: Draft versus final
official_measurement_examples.fact: The 2023 consultation and draft Approved Document T are historical proposal evidence and must not replace the final regulation and current approved document.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Part T Building Regulations compliance does not itself grant planning permission or determine lawful land use.

core_rules: Part T compliance is not planning permission
planning permission is not Part T compliance
Part T applies to buildings other than dwellings within its statutory scope
material change of use must be evidenced for the actual building
toilet type requirement is not a numeric toilet-count rule
Part T is distinct from Part G sanitation and quantity guidance
Part T is distinct from Part M accessibility requirements
2023 consultation proposal is not the final operative rule
draft Approved Document T is not the current approved document
3 November 2025 corrections must not be backdated
schools and other statutory exceptions must be checked against the final regulation
universal toilet provision is not planning permission
single-sex toilet provision is not proof of Part T completion without design evidence
NO_DATA must remain NO_DATA rather than no toilet-accommodation constraint
no parcel toilet-accommodation clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
